column1: # Group U of the window checks (package UI-0c of docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md; docs/port-notes/UI-0c.md): the common windows the other
# groups do not reach, the main window at fixed sizes with each module, and the patient dashboard. Each row is one check and one picture of
# the UI refresh's galleries (G-UI2, G-UI3) and of the check U0. Ids and picture names are kept once given (the approvals in
# UiApproved/approved.tsv are keyed by picture); a new window gets the next id.
#   id       U<n> a window, UM<n> the main window, UD<n> the patient dashboard
#   picture  the picture's file name in the results folder (the gallery's name for it)
#   window   the window's type: a Form, or the Frm a FormFrame hosts (FormOpenDental for the main window)
#   patient  yes: patient #1 is selected first; no: the window does not need one (UM: no means no patient is selected)
#   module   the module the check goes to first (an EnumModuleType name), or -
#   opened   how the program opens it, the way a person's click does:
#            menu        the main menu item at the path (its PerformClick)
#            handler     the module's handler method a click runs (module field.method)
#            button      the module's button (module field.button field), its PerformClick
#            grid        a double-click on a module grid's row (module field.grid field | tag:<row tag>[;<tag>...] or text:<cell text>)
#            accountrow  a double-click on the Account grid's first row whose account table column is not 0
#            script      a script of InProcChecks.U.cs (ScriptU<target>), for a window opened from another window
#            main        the main window at the size, in the module, with or without patient #1
#            dashboard   the patient dashboard with a widget sheet definition (a synthetic one is added to the scratch copy when it has none)
#            none        the synthetic dump cannot fill the window: target says why; the check is SKIPPED with that reason
#   guard    the tables the window could write, comma-separated (their row counts are compared before and after), or -
